The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 12: Wild Card Qualifier''' was the tournament held on August 8, 2021 to determine the seed for the [[2021 AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 12|AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 12]].
